data.summary: I compared these figures with NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2025 results, and they match: revenue of $130.5B (FY2024: $60.9B), net income of about $72.9B, operating income of about $81.5B, total assets of $111.6B and cash and cash equivalents of about $8.6B. As the note asked, I didn't check or include the revenue growth figure.
